integrity: Analytic proof gives exact finite spectra and entropy limits. Standalone arithmetic/Fourier numerical checks corroborate finite identities but do not replace the proof; the priority comparison is limited to the cited literature.
scientific_limitations: Only the stated unweighted, loopless stride-three circulant family and Haar entropy are classified. Neutral modes occur when the number of sites is divisible by three; no ergodicity is asserted. The singular integrals are finite and evaluated numerically only as diagnostics. Earlier equivalent limit theorems under alternate terminology cannot be completely excluded.
title: Arithmetic entropy bifurcation in stride-three coupled cat maps
